desc: The head drifts toward screen-right more than the body: nose x 0.378 to 0.474 and chin x 0.421 to 0.491 over the chunk. This is partly the push-in (expansion centre left of frame centre) and partly the head turning and shifting toward the lens. Torso, arms and hands move essentially only with the zoom.
No finger articulation. The right hand (forearm on top) stays draped over the rail and the left hand hangs below it at screen-left of centre; positions change only with the push-in.
No distinct sway; only faint shimmer at the edges of the hair ends. Ahoge, ear fins, bows and whale tail are static.

Defocused foreground head sinks toward the bottom edge with the push-in (head top y about 0.786 to 0.87). Face profile visible f1-10, cut by the frame edge f11-18, only hair from about f19, crown only by f33-36.
Overall frame luma rises slightly, 59.5 to 63.3.

Slow stepped push-in toward DS. Cumulative scale is about 1.15 (digest), or about 1.16-1.17 measured on DS and the rail, by f36. The rail top moves down (y about 0.642 to 0.718) while DS's headdress moves up, so the expansion centre sits at about y 0.2 (DS's eye/forehead height). Its x is poorly constrained (about 0.25-0.4, left of frame centre). Motion comes in bursts at 4-6, 9-11, 14-16, 19-21, 24-26, 29-31 and 34-36, with near-static frames 8, 13, 18, 23, 28 and 33. There is no measurable camera roll: the rail slope (higher at screen-left, about 1.3-1.5 deg) changes by less than 0.3 deg, so the digest's per-frame rot_deg values (summing to about +2.3 deg) do not come from the camera.
Chin lowers about 6-8 deg (pitch about +8 to 0) as the eyes drop. The eyes move down on screen even though the push-in moves content up.
Gaze moves from up and off-screen left down toward the lens. At f10-13 the irises are lowered and near-centred under half-closed lids. Eye contact is settled with open eyes at f14-15.
Face yaw eases from about -24 to -12 toward the camera. The nose dash moves from x about 0.379 (f10) to 0.404 (f16), about +27 px.
Low confidence: the brows are mostly hidden by the bangs. The lid creases and brow area appear to lower slightly with the squint.
Partial eyelid closure (smiling squint): upper lids about 50% at f10-13, reopening to about 80-85% at f14, fully open at f15. Not a full blink. No blinks anywhere else in the chunk.
Open grin showing teeth and pink inner mouth narrows to a thin crescent smile with only a line of teeth. Main steps are f13 to f14 and f18 to f19.
Head straightens: roll eases from about +6 to +2 (approximate).
Profile drifts right with the push-in and leaves frame at the right edge: a sliver at f24 (maybe f25), gone by f26.

Skin-toned clapping hands appear at lower-left at f15, replacing a grey blurred hand. A dark head sliver is at the left edge from f15, and her smiling face is clear at f19-24. She keeps clapping through f36.
Generative morph: AUD_3's dim face brightens from f16, gains a pink highlight at f19, and reads as a lit, smiling dark-haired man (AUD_4) in the same spot by f20-21.
Slow continued turn toward the camera, yaw about -12 to -6. The nose moves x 0.404 (f16), 0.426 (f24), 0.457 (f30), 0.474 (f36). The f29-31 part is boosted by the camera step.
Second light-blue bow at her right temple (screen-left) comes into view as the face turns frontal: edge first visible at f19, growing through f20-25, clearly a bow from f25 on.
Broad open smile showing teeth is clear from about f24 and stronger by f29-36.
Lips close: the thin parted smile (f28) becomes a closed-lip smile with upturned corners at f29, held to f36.

Largest step of the chunk: scale +1.0% (f29), +1.1% (f30), +0.47% (f31), about 2.6% in total, with content shifting about 13 px right and 15 px up. No visible roll: the digest's +0.43/+0.21/+0.21 deg are not confirmed by the rail.

One hand rises from chest level to about x 0.13-0.2, y 0.41-0.44 (beside DS's hair curl) at f30-31 and is held raised near chin height through f34-36. The other hand stays at the chest (x about 0.04-0.11, y about 0.44-0.49).
A hand with a light wristband rises at the right edge below his face: x about 0.91-0.95, y about 0.47 (f34) to 0.43-0.45 (f36).

slight squaring of the face toward the lens (est. yaw ~-8 -> ~-4 deg; low confidence, based mainly on the nose-highlight shift, MediaPipe shows no clear trend); near-frontal (~-2 to -3) thereafter; head otherwise fixed in the scene

bare arm rises from chin height beside AUD_1's cheek (hand y~0.40, 38-43), through her eye/forehead height (44-46), to overhead by 49, hand ending under/behind DS's right (screen-left) fin tip (y~0.31); elbow near the left edge from 44
defocused foreground back-of-head sinks out of the bottom edge (top 0.875 -> 0.99), gone at 60
forearm with white wristband at the right edge (fist raised) enlarges, blurs into a pale out-of-focus limb and slides right; still a large blur at 53-55, a shrinking sliver at 56-60, gone at 61

confirmed absences: no blink (eyes fully open in all frames), no gaze shift (irises centred on CAM), no hand/finger motion (R hand draped over the L forearm and rail, L hand hanging over the rail), no independent hair/fin/ribbon/tail sway; all apparent motion is the camera
no lighting change; mean luma rises 63.4 -> 73.0 and blue fraction 0.318 -> 0.398 only because DS fills more of the frame
audio: onsets at 39-40, 47, 54-55, 69-70; beats at 47 and 62 fall on dup frames; loudness trough -27.4 dB at 66, back to -10.2 dB at 70; no visible character motion answers any beat/onset

continuous slow push-in, dolly-like with parallax (foreground AUD_4 sinks faster and background AUD_3 drifts outward less than DS scales): cumulative scale x1.21 by 71, ~+1% per new 24p image; effective anchor ~(0.42,0.21) on DS's upper head; holds (dup + near-dup) at 42-43, 47-48, 52-53, 57-58, 62-63, 67-68; 38 is a near-hold (x1.0002)
small roll drift: cumulative +0.10 deg at 41, peak +0.77 deg at 61-63, unwinding to +0.36 deg at 71
face morphs/shifts up (hairline jumps up at 44), then dims as AUD_2's forearm crosses her lower face (46); not discernible from 49
extra raised hand (fingers up) appears above DS's right (screen-left) fin tip at 49 ~(0.19-0.26,0.23-0.30), clearly visible through 53, fades behind the enlarging fin at 54-55, gone by 56
laugh opens wide with upper teeth visible (widest ~56-61); face heavily defocused, low confidence
small out-of-focus hands at the far-left edge (0.0-0.04,0.52-0.56); dim mid-right figure with hands up ~(0.85-0.88,0.38-0.45) at 54-59
arm held overhead with the hand behind DS's right (screen-left) fin tip, slight drift only
partial smile relaxation: closed-lip U smile narrows (~25-30%) and flattens; first visible at 59 (58 is a near-dup of 56), clearer 61-66, shortest/flattest 69-71; lips never part
viewer danmaku timed here: '大肥鱼！' and 'claude：看什么，中国人？'
laugh closes toward a smile (mouth less open); low confidence (defocused)

continuous slow push-in, fixed point ~(0.575,0.20) (top of DS's head/hairline): cumulative scale x1.237 from f73 to f108. Per-frame steps ~+1.1% / +0.6% / +1.2% on f%5 in {4,0,1}. f%5==2 frames are exact duplicates and f%5==3 frames are near-static (24->30 fps cadence). Content drifts up-left 3-10 px per moving frame.

held pose: no blink, no gaze shift (eye contact with CAM throughout), no measurable head turn/tilt (<1 deg relative roll drift), no hand/finger/torso motion, no hair/fin/ribbon sway. Camera-compensated differences on her body show only edge outlines.
no lighting cue; mean luma rises 72.9 -> 81.0 only because the push-in crops the dark background and DS's white blouse/apron fills more of the frame

closed-mouth U smile fades gradually: clear U at 73-76, biggest drop 76->78 to a weak U, faint residual upturn (corners slightly above centre) 78-85, level line by 86. Width ~0.088 -> ~0.075 face-widths.
smiling dark-haired woman's face becomes visible at the left edge (from 76) and clearer as the arm stops covering it
beat on duplicate frame; no motion response
audio: loudness step rms -27 -> -13 dB with onsets at 80/81, during the late (residual) phase of DS's smile fade; no visible motion response
strongest scene residual motion of the chunk is at the left-edge crowd (AUD_1 arm/face region, compensated diff peak at 78->79), decaying after f86

raised arm at the left edge morphs from a diagonal forearm (elbow at left edge) to a more vertical one, with the hand lower (~y0.31 -> ~y0.37). It then fades behind DS's hair and is no longer distinguishable from f89.
framing: ahoge loop leaves through the top edge (push-in), only the stem is left
framing: draped left hand is progressively cut by the bottom edge (tips at 80, wrist out by ~101). A sliver of the back of the hand stays visible at the bottom edge through 108.
framing: chrome rail post (lower-left) and curled hair-strand tip (left edge) leave frame

mouth corners drift into a very faint downturn (each half of the line arches down at its outer end). Barely there from ~89, consistent from ~98/99, strongest 104-108. It is continuous and does not flicker on and off.
a pale raised hand appears above-left of AUD_2's face at the right edge (faint 91-93, clear 94-100) and is gone at 101
warm-lit blurred head/hand with bright orange specks appears at the left beside AUD_1 (~0.03-0.08, 0.36-0.42), then blends into the warm crowd
beat on duplicate frame; no motion response; danmaku 大肥鱼！ around 91-95
framing: right fingertips leave the bottom edge
AUD_2's face turns warm orange-lit (background generation morph): onset at 99, fully warm by 101, stays warm through 108
framing: railing shrinks to a thin band at the bottom edge and leaves frame by 105
a raised forearm/hand appears just below DS's right ear fin at the left (~0.06-0.12, 0.36-0.40); more forearm visible by 106
beat on duplicate frame; no motion response
raised hand at upper-left edge: full 109, half 110, gone 111 (replaced by AUD_3 warm-lit head; generative morph)
framing: white left cuff peeks under the right wrist at the bottom edge 109-113 and shrinks with the push-in; out of frame from 114

continuous slow push-in with its fixed point near DS head-top (solved fixed point x~0.43-0.47, y~0.06-0.10; head_top y stays ~0.077): cumulative scale ~x1.19 (SIFT 1.190, digest 1.185). Content below moves down (nose y 0.361->0.414, chin 0.458->0.530), slight rightward drift (~+0.014 x)
no blink and no gaze shift for all 36 frames (1.2 s): eyes fully open, irises centred on lens (checked on every non-dup frame)
no mouth articulation: closed two-stroke lip line throughout; only render shimmer of the stroke
none: head roll fixed at about -2.5 deg (top toward screen-left), yaw/pitch unchanged; head rigid over torso
none: locks, ahoge, fins, frills static; only small edge shimmer on push-in step frames
no light change on DS; frame luma 82.3 -> 91.7 (136) -> 89.0 and blue fraction 0.396 -> 0.455 come only from reframing onto bright costume and blue hair
warm-lit head top appears at left edge

framing: right hand leaves frame through the push-in. Fingertips cut at 111, dorsum only 114-118, cuff + top of dorsum 119-123, sliver 124-128, gone at 129. Hand and fingers never move on their own (forearms rest on the off-frame barrier railing)

cadence hold: 112 exact dup, 113 near-dup (absdiff 0.87); same pattern at 117-118, 122-123, 127-128, 132-133, 137-138, 142-143. Big steps on frames ending 4/9, ~+0.3-0.5% steps on frames ending 0/1 and 5/6
push-in step ~+2.0%
audio: loud onset (rms -20.7 -> -12.5 dB, onsets 114-115); no visible reaction by DS or crowd
framing: both fin tips now cut by side edges
push-in step ~+1.8-1.9%
push-in step ~+1.75-1.9% (on music beat 124, cadence coincidence)
push-in parallax gradually cuts AUD_4 with DS screen-right hair and the right edge. Partial face (~60 px) at 124-129, blurrier at 134, faint sliver by 139-144
push-in step ~+1.75-1.85%
push-in step ~+1.4%; framing becomes chest-up
push-in step ~+1.4% (on music beat 139, cadence coincidence)
framing: lower corset button row leaves bottom edge
push-in step ~+1.1%
tail of the shot-1 slow push-in on DS's face: scale x1.0026/frame at 145, x1.0027 at 146, x1.0002 at 148 (settling); ~1 px up-left drift
sustained direct eye contact with the lens: eyes fully open with irises centred, no blink, small closed mouth, no head motion (a hold before the cut)
hard cut: frontal MCU of DS facing camera -> rear over-the-shoulder view of DS facing into the club; luma 90->35, blue fraction 0.46->0.63

camera-induced exit of DS's left-side features through the left frame edge: the left fin (always edge-cropped) shrinks from 149 to ~156, is a sliver at 158 and is gone by ~159. The left hair bow is visible to ~158, appears as slivers 159-161 and is gone by 163 (only the headdress frill stays at the edge). The left shoulder ruffle sliver (149-154) and the left pale-blue strands (to ~158) also leave the frame

continuous rightward arc around DS: DS slides ~235 px left (hair-region tracking); the mid-ground crowd/bokeh lights slide ~150 px right and ~30 px up (warm-light tracking); cumulative clockwise image roll ~+1.5-2.5 deg; net push-in ~x1.006. Per-frame steps follow a fixed 5-frame cadence (largest on 154,159,164,169,174,179), a frame-rate-conversion artefact that does not follow the 15-frame beat grid
DS completely static: no head turn, limb, fin, hair or ruffle motion detectable beyond rigid camera-induced translation/roll. The apparent yaw drifts ~178->~166 deg only because of the camera arc
music beat; no character motion aligned to it (the coincident large step is the 5-frame camera cadence)

the rim-lit outer contour of DS's right sleeve comes fully inside the right frame edge (~156) and the sleeve widens. The pale-blue under-layer of her right-side hair becomes more exposed and brighter as the camera arcs to her right. This is a view change, not independent hair sway

blue-lit audience member emerges from behind DS's right-side pale strands. A faint blue glow is present at 158; the figure is faint 159-163 and distinct from 164. It drifts right and grows with parallax; an arm appears raised from ~176. No independent motion is separable from parallax

audience member with both arms raised overhead in an arch/ring. Barely discernible at 159; clearly readable from ~161 next to a warm light; drifts right to the right frame edge (touching it at 180). No pose change is separable from parallax

a metal balcony railing tube enters at the bottom-right corner at f159 (x~0.97-1.0, y~0.93-0.94; warm glints of a lower rail visible at the very corner from ~156). It lengthens leftward to x~0.85-0.87 by f180, showing DS standing at a balcony railing above the crowd
more warm lights and blue-lit figures enter frame as DS slides left; frame luma 36->39, blue fraction ~0.646->0.655-0.665
progressive focus/depth-of-field change: the crowd becomes noticeably sharper (raised arms, heads, blue-lit figures legible by 174-180) while DS stays sharp
music beat; no character motion aligned to it (the coincident large step is the 5-frame camera cadence)

Continuous truck/arc to the right around DS, with a slow push-in and tilt. DS (foreground) slides screen-left ~280 px at the bow/fin (template tracking) and rises ~17 px. Against the digest at frame 180, the far background shifts +43 px right and 179 px up, with cumulative scale 1.083 and roll ~6.8 deg. The floor crowd around CL moves only ~+52/-21 px in frame from 199 to 216 (parallax between the floor and the far balconies). The sweep gradually uncovers CL
DS holds completely still: template tracking shows only translation (no head turn or roll), consistent with camera motion alone
continuous dancing/swaying with several raised arms; soft-focused until 198, sharp from ~205
Audio: the music energy hits, rms -27 dB (183) -> -16.6 (185) -> -9.8 (186) -> -5.6 (188), with onsets at 187-190. The crowd is already dancing; no visible sync change
strongest camera step: background up 34 px, roll +1.4 deg, scale +1.6% between 190 and 191 (plus +0.8 deg roll at 188)

CL first glimpse: an orange hair crown peeks between DS's light-blue hair strands at x 0.433->0.415, y~0.55, with a pale face sliver from ~191. The patch drifts ~25 px left with DS while the background moves right (generation artefact)
DS's light-blue inner strands below the fin spread into looser wavy lines (subtle; partly camera parallax); her head, bow, fin and headband otherwise rigid
A ceiling spotlight beam emerges at top centre as DS's head slides away. From 199 there is a warm haze glow and a bright floor pool around CL. Mean luma rises 39.1 -> 44.0
AUD_3 (facing the camera, glasses) keeps his LEFT arm, on the screen-right of his head, raised straight up with a clenched fist throughout; he drifts with the camera

Generation morph: the peeking head patch turns into an elongated orange hand-like form with a whitish base at (0.385-0.415, 0.54-0.58). It could read as a raised right hand, palm to camera, but it is hair-coloured and at 196-198 it collapses into the orange lock on her screen-left side. Her white blouse appears ~45 px to the right at 194-195, and at 196 her real head reappears at (0.45, 0.547) behind a DS strand
CL's head/face resolves: black ribbon (196), closed eyes + gold flower + bow tie (198), full clear face above DS's ruffle (199)
Rack focus from the DS foreground plane to the dance floor/CL plane. Crowd edge energy rises 35 (198) -> 79 (199) -> 146 (201) -> 225 (205) -> 355 (211), and DS's ruffle becomes visibly soft
eyes stay closed in every frame (dark lash arcs, no iris); no blink, no opening

CL stays in place. Her in-frame head displacement from 199 to 216 is (+52,-21) px, matching neighbours AUD_1 (+57,-26), AUD_2 (+54,-24) and AUD_3 (+64,-14), so there is no measurable advance toward the balcony. Her legs are hidden by the long skirt
slight progressive head roll toward screen-left (her right), from ~-1 deg to ~-6 deg (head-top vs chin offset 1 px -> 6.5 px)
AUD_1 keeps both hands at her waist handling a small object, head bowed; slight sway
AUD_2 (bald, dark suit, in profile toward screen-left) holds a hand out at waist height next to AUD_1's hands; both look down at them (apparent hand-off of a small object/drink)
A long orange lock on her screen-left side fans outward. Its outer edge moves from x~0.40 at 199 to ~0.375 at 204-206

AUD_5 (glasses, lower-right foreground): the top of her head is visible from ~201 behind DS's blurred strand, and her face/glasses are clear from 204. AUD_6 (hands raised to face) is uncovered at ~205-206
skirt: orange front panel and black-trimmed side flap swung toward screen-right; looks more vertical at 214-216 once the full skirt is uncovered (partly a disocclusion effect)
left hand (screen-right) keeps its fingers curled around the dangling black-and-gold charm at the skirt front; steady hold
The left (screen-right) elbow/sleeve flares outward ~10-14 px relative to her neck. The wrist cuff stays nearly in place (~5 px)
AUD_4's dark head (back to camera) appears at 211 in front of CL's skirt hem as DS's sleeve slides past, and stays there, occluding the hem centre
the screen-left locks fall back toward her body (outer edge x ~0.41 -> 0.42)

Her right forearm and cuff are uncovered at 214 on the skirt's screen-left side by the hip; the hand is blurred behind DS's out-of-focus ruffle edge at 214-215. At 216 the hand is clearly visible resting open on the front of her right thigh, fingers spread downward (0.444-0.46, 0.60-0.615). The cuff stays at x~0.44-0.446, so the change is mostly disocclusion rather than travel

slow arc right + tilt down + push-in: bg +58px x, -91px y, scale x1.043, roll +1.55deg; parallax: DS slides left ~170-205px (fin tip 204, shoulder 179, elbow 171), CL drifts right/up ~80/48px; cadence frames 220,225,...,250 carry half motion
DS fully static at rail (bow/fin/ruffle layout fixed); no head turn, no hair sway; white sleeve cuff at elbow corner becomes more visible from ~229 (camera-arc reveal only)
composition, camera-induced: the static fin axis comes into line with CL (angle gap ~45deg at 218, ~18deg at 236, ~9deg at 244, ~3deg at 251); fin effectively aimed at CL from ~244

R hand slides from outer skirt edge to front of R thigh: wrist rel x -45 -> -27px, fingertips -42 -> -15px; hand-tip separation 71 -> 52px; fingers stay spread downward throughout; L hand stays on gold ornament/tassel
eyes closed throughout: no blink, no gaze shift, no visible mouth change (checked on face crops of all 28 unique frames)

AUD_2 = man with glasses, light grey-blue shirt, upper-right of CL (head ~(0.79,0.52)->(0.87,0.49)); holds L fist raised above head throughout, fist ~fixed relative to head (slight sway only); face turned screen-left toward CL, a little more in profile by 251
AUD_3 = bowed figure with slicked-back dark hair and bright crown highlights, lower right next to DS sleeve (head ~(0.69,0.84)->(0.75,0.81)); both fists held at nose/mouth, static, no measurable rise
continuous dancing; black-dress dancers behind CL step and sway; raised arms mid-crowd; a dancer's hand reaches in above-right of CL at 244-251
gradual brightening luma 44.0 -> 46.6; spot beam + haze steady; lamp-lit left mezzanine revealed as DS slides left
screen-left overskirt fans out, hem rel x -43 -> -100px, black patterned lining + lace petticoat revealed (held to ~234)
hidden hips sway (inferred from skirt), driving skirt to screen-left; torso leans slightly to her R
screen-left (her R) hair locks swing out from the sleeve

AUD_4 (long dark wavy hair, dark dress, right of AUD_1 at clearing edge, head ~(0.63,0.65)) turns her face from profile facing partner AUD_5 (screen-right, faces close) to near-frontal toward camera, chin down; holds that to 251
arms straighten into hands-on-thighs brace; elbows bow out (L rel x 50->60->57) and drop (rel y 93/100 -> 107)
AUD_4's hand slides from AUD_5's collar down onto his chest, fingers spread; stays there to 251. AUD_5 (light-blue shirt) keeps his head bowed toward her
skirt swing reverses: left fan -96 -> -66px, right hem +74 -> +102px
head becomes more upright/frontal: roll -10 -> -6deg, yaw -9 -> -4deg, still bowed (eyes closed)
side lean straightens into a symmetric forward bend; shoulders slightly hunched
screen-right locks fan further out beyond L arm

Continuous slow move. Background content rises and drifts right: digest-integrated (+22.6, -56.7) px; template matches give mezzanine (+31,-46) and crowd around CL (+16..+30, -43..-55). Cumulative scale 1.0104 (~1.0% push-in, not 1.2%). The foreground DS moves the opposite way: ruffle -42 px, cuff (-70,-50), fin-like point (-90,-35). That is 65-120 px of leftward parallax relative to the background, not ~45 px. Reads as a slow arc/truck to the right around CL combined with a tilt/crane down.

No blink. The eyes stay narrow, near-closed lash lines; the lash darkness is constant in face-aligned crops and the iris is not resolvable at a ~52 px face. The pale lid highlight above her left eye fades gradually from ~273 with the head roll; this is not a lid movement. No mouth is visible and the expression does not change.

Foreground silhouette drifts left: ruffle centroid x 137 -> 95 px, cuff (460,1530) -> (390,1480), fin-like point tip (250,720) -> (160,685). The parts move by different amounts (head point -90 px, ruffle -42 px), so a slight head/upper-body shift of DS's own cannot be fully excluded. There is no clear gesture, and her face is never visible.

Bob-haired woman in a black dress at the front rim, back to camera, facing CL; no gestures. Her head rises only ~14 px in frame (crown 1200 -> 1186 px) versus ~44 px for CL. Her x goes 657 -> 673 (263) -> 667 px, consistent with near-subject parallax or a slight sway.

Woman in a black mini dress behind-right of CL bobs in place with her feet planted. She stands upright with head bowed and arms hanging slightly out at 253-261, leans a little forward with knees flexing at 264-276, and bends more at 273-283. The bald man on her screen-right keeps a hand reaching toward her left hand/hip throughout.

Continuous dancing. Raised arms upper-left (~0.37,0.35) and right of the beam (~0.82,0.38) sway. The curly-haired couple at the front-right rim rocks together, and the long-haired woman at the front-left rim turns slightly from ~273. A man at bottom-centre has both hands at his head.

Gradual darkening, luma 46.4 -> 44.0. It is concentrated in the left half (44.7 -> 40.8; the DS strip 49.9 -> 41.3) as DS's bright headband and frills leave or turn away; the right half is steady (47.9 -> 47.1). Spotlight beam, haze and floor circle are steady.
Micro jolt: content dx +4.0, dy -6.5 px, rot +0.26 deg, scale +0.21% (largest frame step of the chunk).

Lateral lean toward her own left (screen-right) while the hips go to her right. The head ends ~10 px and the skirt/body ~25 px further screen-left relative to the surrounding crowd, so the head sits over her left side. The shoulder line tilts with her left shoulder lower; the tracker's 9-11 deg is noisy (+/-4 deg, and its r_shoulder sits on the neck). The forward bow itself does not measurably deepen.
Music beat and onset fall on a duplicate frame; no visible accent in any character.

Long back hair shows more and more on screen-left (orange px 128 -> 633) and less on screen-right (485 -> 177). This is mostly a visibility change: the right-arm gap opens, the left arm closes and the torso tilts.
Left arm lowers and closes in, nearly straight by 278. Relative to the face, the wrist slides ~27 px medially and ~15 px down the front of the left thigh.

Counter-roll, top of the head toward screen-left, in two phases. The eye-line angle drops ~3 deg at 258-259, holds through 271, then drops another ~4-5 deg from 273 to 284. Total ~-7 deg, matching the annotated roll going from +3 to -4.
The bespectacled man at the front-left rim, just screen-left of AUD_1, shifts relative to CL. From ~260 his head no longer covers CL's right shin and boot.
White frilled headband and blue bow slide out past the left frame edge: cut from 259, a thin sliver at 266-271, effectively out by 273.

Slow hip/skirt displacement toward her right (screen-left). The skirt-mass centroid goes from +17 to -14.5 px relative to the head axis, and the skirt region moves ~25 px left relative to nearby crowd. Fastest at 266-281, with no reversal inside the chunk.

Weight onto her right leg, inferred only from the pelvis shift (contrapposto). The right white-stocking shin and dark heeled ankle boot appearing below the hem from ~260 is an occlusion change: the bespectacled man's head at the front-left rim stops covering it. It is not direct evidence of the shift. Her left foot stays behind AUD_1's head.

Right arm opens into an akimbo pose. Relative to the face, the elbow moves ~25 px outward and ~7 px up, ending at the outer end of the puff sleeve (~0.516,0.527 at 288). The wrist travels ~32 px outward and ~14 px up, from the front of the thigh onto the right hip.
Fingers of both hands stay splayed and pressed on the skirt, pointing down, while the hands slide; no finger flexion is visible.
Skirt hem swings toward screen-left. The left hem edge goes from -57 to -97 px from the head axis and the right edge from +101 to +63 px. The flower ornament and ribbons hang still.
Audio onset; no visible discrete change.
Tiny yaw drift: ~+5 deg at 264 to ~-7 deg at 286 (face-centre offset). Near the resolution limit.
